evidence.rationale: Scenario 2: claim past TTL not released makes step appear owned. Read-only check claim_ts + ttl < now -> action=stale_claim_detected, suggested_next=claim_refresh_or_release. No auto-release (lifecycle mutation forbidden by constraints).

Scenario 5: detect children done but parent evidence not backfilled. Read-only diagnostic emits action=parent_evidence_backfill_required + suggested_next, never mutates. Natural extension of parent_aggregation already in this file.

Scenario 7: parent shows ready while a descendant is blocked. Recursive read-only scan of child statuses; if any descendant blocked, report keep_blocked_hidden_child_required instead of ready. Fail-closed (treat unknown child status as blocking).

Scenario 4: child id in parent manifest but file absent on disk. Deterministic existence check -> action=missing_child_file, keep parent blocked (fail-closed) rather than counting absent child as done.
Scenario 3: child evidence mtime older than child source mtime -> evidence stale. Read-only mtime compare -> action=stale_child_evidence, do not certify parent on stale child. Fail-closed.
